Robinson Aims to Complement McCaffrey in 49ers’ Backfield
Robinson, who is a larger, downhill running back, said he is comfortable with transitioning to Kyle Shanahan’s outside zone scheme.

New San Francisco 49ers running back Brian Robinson thinks he and Christian McCaffrey can become the best duo in the league.
The 49ers acquired Robinson in a trade with the Washington Commanders over the weekend. The Commanders’ third-round draft pick in 2022, Robinson carved out a role as the traditional ball carrier complementing receiving backs. At his introductory
press conference
on Monday, the fourth-year pro said he is ready to accept that role again in head coach Kyle Shanahan’s offense.
